translation.name: Biblica® Bhaibheri Dzvene Rakasununguka MuChiShona Chanhasi 2017

content: Shure kwaizvozvi ndakaona mumwe mutumwa achiburuka kubva kudenga. Akanga ane simba guru, uye nyika yakavhenekerwa nokubwinya kwake.

content.text: ugaro hweshiri dzose dzine tsvina nedzinonyangadza.
uye vashambadziri venyika vakapfuma kubva pazvinofadza zvaro zvizhinji.”

content: Ipapo ndakanzwa rimwe inzwi kudenga richiti:

content.text: kuti murege kugovana naro muzvivi zvaro,
kuti murege kugamuchira matambudziko aro api zvawo;
nokuti zvivi zvaro zvaita murwi unosvika kudenga,
Naizvozvo, nezuva rimwe chete matambudziko ake achamukunda anoti:

content: “Madzimambo enyika, akaita upombwe naro uye akagovana naro pamufaro waro achati achiona utsi hwokutsva kwaro, achachema uye achaungudza pamusoro paro.
Vachitya kurwadziwa kwaro, vachamira kure vagochema vachiti:

content.text: Kuparara kwako kwasvika muawa imwe chete!’

content: “Vashambadziri venyika vachachema uye vachaungudza pamusoro paro nokuti hakuna munhu achatenga nhumbi dzavozve,

nhumbi dzegoridhe, sirivha, mabwe anokosha namaparera; micheka yakanaka, yepepuru, sirika nemicheka mitsvuku; mhando dzose dzemiti inonhuhwira nezvinhu zvemhando dzose zvakagadzirwa nenyanga dzenzou, namatanda ano mutengo unokosha, ndarira, simbi namabwe akaurungana;
nhumbi dzesinamoni nezvinonhuhwira, mura nezvizoro zvinonhuhwira, waini namafuta omuorivhi, upfu hwakatsetseka negorosi; mombe namakwai; mabhiza nengoro; nemiviri nemweya yavanhu.
“Vachati, ‘Muchero wawaipanga wabviswa kwauri. Upfumi hwako hwose nezvinobwinya zvako zvose zvapera, hazvichazowanikwizve.’
Vashambadziri vakatengesa zvinhu izvi uye vakawana pfuma yavo kwariri vachamira kure, vachityiswa nokurwadziwa kwaro. Vachachema uye vachaungudza

content.text: uye unotaima negoridhe, namatombo anokosha namaparera!
Muawa imwe chete upfumi hwakakura kudai hwaparara!’

content: “Vafambisi vose vezvikepe mugungwa, navose vanofamba nezvikepe, vashandi vomuzvikepe navose vanorarama nezvinobva mugungwa, vachamira kure.
Pavachaona utsi hwokutsva kwaro, vachati, ‘Pakambova neguta rakaita seguta guru iri here?’
Vachakanda guruva pamisoro yavo, uye nokuchema nokuungudza vachadanidzira vachiti:
Ipapo mutumwa ane simba akasimudza dombo rakaenzana neguyo guru akarikanda mugungwa, akati:

content.text: Kuimba kwavaridzi vorudimbwa navaimbi, navaridzi venyere navaridzi vehwamanda,
Vashambadziri vako vakanga vari vakuru venyika.
